text: dsh-water-reminder 是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的饮水和活动提醒插件。它分别按随机间隔提醒喝水、起身活动或远眺，并支持安静时段。插件提供记录饮水与休息、查询目标进度、暂停或调整提醒的工具，以及侧栏倒计时面板、设置页和 hydration-coach 技能。通知可通过系统、对话或浏览器送达。适合希望在工作会话中养成补水和离座休息习惯的用户。数据保存在本机 DSH 目录，不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-water-reminder adds water and movement reminders to DeepSeek Harness. Tools log drinks and breaks, track daily goals, and control schedules. A sidebar shows progress and countdowns; settings adjust timing. OS, chat and browser notifications are supported. State stays local; no API key is needed.
工作时总忘记喝水，想让电脑定时提醒我。
能不能记录我每天喝了多少水，还差多少到目标？
DSH 老是让我久坐，我想隔一阵收到起身活动或远眺提示。
我想查看今天的饮水进度、连续达标天数和下一次提醒时间。
提醒来得太频繁时，怎么先暂停或推迟一会儿？
让我的 DSH 侧栏显示喝水倒计时和最近几天的摄入记录。
Remind me to drink water while I work and track how much I have had today.
I need occasional prompts to stand up, stretch, move around, or rest my eyes during long sessions.
dsh-water-reminder 的功能「随机饮水提醒」：后台按可配置的随机间隔安排喝水提示，并计算今日摄入与目标差额。触发后可发送系统通知和对话提示。
dsh-water-reminder 的功能「饮水记账」：用户可通过工具或侧栏记录一杯水及毫升数，并查看每日目标进度、杯数和连续达标天数。记录写入本地状态文件。
dsh-water-reminder 的功能「久坐与护眼提示」：独立计时器随机提醒用户站起、活动或看远处，也可分别配置间隔和提示类型；面板与工具可记录已完成的休息。
dsh-water-reminder 的功能「侧栏进度面板」：点击网页侧栏按钮查看饮水目标、倒计时、七日摄入图和活动提醒，并可记一杯、稍后提醒、暂停或立即触发。
dsh-water-reminder 的功能「可调提醒设置」：网页设置页可修改饮水目标、杯量、两条提醒节奏、安静时段、通知方式及提示开关，保存后同步到运行中的调度。
dsh-water-reminder 的使用须知：计时与记录依赖 Harness 进程运行；状态保存在 $DSH_HOME/water-reminder.json，默认位于本机 DSH 目录。

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · dsh-water-reminder：A **hydration and posture reminder** plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

People forget to drink while they are deep in work — and just as often forget to stand up. While a session is live this plugin runs **two independent reminder tracks**, and delivers each reminder through three independent channels — missing one still leaves two:

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · dsh-water-reminder：| Track | What it nudges about | Default rhythm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 💧 Hydration | Today's intake and how much is left | every **40–60 minutes, drawn at random** |
| 🚶 Movement | Standing up and stretching, moving around, looking into the distance (eye strain) | every **45–70 minutes, drawn at random** |

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · dsh-water-reminder：| Channel | How it lands | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🖥️ OS notification | `osascript` on macOS, a WinRT toast on Windows, `notify-send` on Linux | `ctx.subprocess` (part of dsh-base) |
| 💬 In-conversation nudge | a plugin message injected into every live root session, so the assistant says one line | the `agents` service |
| 🔔 Browser notification | the sidebar panel watches `reminderSeq` and the tab raises its own notification | page open + user permission |

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · dsh-water-reminder：The two tracks keep their own rhythm, their own on/off switch, and their own state — **pausing one leaves the other running**. Plus a **sidebar countdown panel**, a **settings page**, and an embedded `hydration-coach` **skill**.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Why 40–60 at random：The irregularity is the point. A perfectly regular timer is what teaches people to ignore it — which is why "drink water on the hour" apps get switched off. Redrawing the interval from the band on every reminder keeps the rhythm unpredictable, which is what makes it work.

The movement track works the same way, and it also draws the *reminder content*: stand up and stretch, move around, or look into the distance. Random, so the nudge does not decay into one repeated sentence.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · or from a packed tarball：Then reload the harness. On DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.1-alpha.3 with hot reload enabled, code updates to this plugin apply without a restart; a fresh install (and toggling the load-time switches `promptSection` / `skill`) still needs one — restart `dsh web`. Never keep two `water-reminder` rows in one profile — each would start its own timer and register the `/water/api` prefix route, and the duplicate route makes the whole plugin tree fail to boot.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · or from a packed tarball：> Recreating a profile with `dsh … --from-default-profile` **replaces** that profile, including its plugins — re-add the plugin afterwards.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Hydration track：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `water_status` | Today's intake, remaining, cups, goal streak, current band, quiet hours, next reminder, 7-day series |
| `water_log` | Record a cup (defaults to the configured cup size; accepts `milliliters` and `note`). Append-only, never deduplicated |
| `water_snooze` | Defer the next reminder; defaults to 5 minutes |
| `water_control` | `start` / `stop` / `set-band` / `set-goal` / `remind-now` / `reset` |

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Movement track：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `posture_status` | Breaks taken today, next break reminder, current band, which nudges are enabled, last break |
| `posture_log` | Record one break (`action` is `stand` / `move` / `distance`; accepts `note`) |
| `posture_control` | `start` / `stop` / `set-band` / `remind-now` / `reset` |

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Movement track：`water_control` and `posture_control` write **runtime overrides** into the state file rather than editing the profile config; `reset` drops those overrides and falls back to configuration.
@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Configuration：In the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (defaults ship in the plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`):

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Configuration：| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Whether the hydration loop runs at start-up |
| `intervalMinMinutes` | number | `40` | Lower bound of the hydration interval, in minutes |
| `intervalMaxMinutes` | number | `60` | Upper bound of the hydration interval, in minutes |
| `dailyGoalMl` | number | `2000` | Daily intake goal |
| `cupMl` | number | `250` | Milliliters recorded for one "cup" |
| `snoozeMinutes` | number | `5` | Default deferral for `water_snooze` |
| `quietHours.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Hold reminders inside a local-time window |
| `quietHours.from` / `.to` | string | `22:00` / `08:00` | The window (may wrap past midnight); a draw inside it resumes at the window's end |
| `posture.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Whether the movement loop runs at start-up |
| `posture.intervalMinMinutes` | number | `45` | Lower bound of the movement interval, in minutes |
| `posture.intervalMaxMinutes` | number | `70` | Upper bound of the movement interval, in minutes |
| `posture.stand` | boolean | `true` | May deliver the "stand up and stretch" nudge |
| `posture.move` | bool

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Configuration：The band is clamped to `[5, 720]` minutes (`[10, 360]` for the movement track), the goal to `[200, 20000]` ml, and the cup to `[50, 2000]` ml. **A user patch replaces the whole entry config**, so restate every field you want to keep when overriding one.

At least one movement nudge always survives: if all three are switched off, the track falls back to "stand up" rather than becoming a silent timer.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Web surfaces：- **Sidebar footer 💧 button** — carries the live countdown to the next hydration reminder (shows "Paused" while off, ✅ once the goal is met). The panel has today's progress bar, cups/streak/band, next reminder, **next movement reminder with today's break count**, a 7-day bar chart, `+250ml` logging, snooze, remind-now, pause/resume, a **"take a break" logger**, and a control to grant browser-notification permission.
- **Settings page** — the full rhythm/goal/quiet-hours/channels form plus a **"Movement and eye breaks" section** (switch, band, and one toggle per nudge). Writes land in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` and hot-reload; changing a band or quiet hours rearms the timer immediately.
@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Web surfaces：The two switches marked "(restart)" (`promptSection`, `skill`) are read at load time and need a Harness reload.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Skill：`skill.js` is the single source of truth and `npm test` asserts the checked-in SKILL.md matches the embedded body byte for byte, so the two delivery paths cannot drift. Run `npm run skill` after editing the body.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Skill：The skill covers which tool to call when, how to react to both reminder kinds (`[water-reminder]` and `[posture-reminder]`) — one short line, no health lecture, never derail the current task — logging rules, how to retune each track's rhythm, estimating a personal goal from body weight (30 ml × kg), and tone/safety boundaries (no medical claims).

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · How the reminder loops behave：- **The state file owns the state.** Timers, next due times, the intake log, and the break log live in `$DSH_HOME/water-reminder.json`, written through a temp file plus rename so a crash cannot truncate it. Both tracks share one file (hydration at the top level, movement under `posture`), so an existing state file keeps working.
- **No backlog after a restart.** A stale `nextDueAt` draws a fresh interval instead of firing the missed reminders at once.
- **Quiet hours** push a draw inside the window to the window's end rather than redrawing, so the behaviour stays predictable. Both tracks share that window.
- **A manual reminder leaves the rhythm alone.** `remind-now` delivers once without resetting the pending reminder.
- **Disposal drains.** Unloading the plugin waits for an already-queued state write, so a cup logged at the last moment is not lost.
- **The timers are `unref()`ed**, so neither reminder loop keeps the process alive.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Known limitations：- **Reminders only exist while Harness is alive.** There is no email, SMS, or push channel. With the process down, only the OS notification path exists — and only while it is up.
- **The Windows toast needs WinRT**, invoked as `powershell -EncodedCommand` (UTF-16LE base64) so quoting and CJK text are safe. If PowerShell is restricted by policy the reminder degrades to a log line, while the other two channels still fire.
- **Browser notifications need a user gesture** to request permission; the 🔔 control in the panel is that gesture.
- **The 7-day series is panel-only.** `water_status` returns a compact one-line text form instead, which keeps the tool's output schema free of nested arrays.
- **The movement track counts breaks, not duration.** `posture_log` records "you took a break", not how long it lasted or how many rounds. Finer tracking needs its own tool.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：The plugin has **zero runtime dependencies** — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `dsh-llm`, `schemastery` and
friends are peer dependencies that the Harness supplies at runtime.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：```sh
pnpm install        # resolves the pinned devDependencies
npm test            # 91 pass / 0 skip, including the real cordis composition tests
```

> **Companion versions.** `0.2.2-rc.1` is paired with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.1.0` and
> `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `3.19.0` (both real releases on their own `latest` channel now).
> The `rc.1` release has no dedicated `dsh-0-2-2-*` dist-tag —
> the exact version strings in `devDependencies` are the only source of truth.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：> **Tool executor.** Since `0.2.2-alpha.2` the tool registry no longer owns the model-facing tool
> descriptions: assembling the system prompt asks the registry for its executor and throws
> `TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE` when the composition has none. A real deployment gets one from
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`; any composition you build by hand has to mount
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-native` after the registry, which is what
> `test/integration.test.js` does.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：If you prefer to reuse the packages from an existing local Harness profile (fastest, offline):

```sh
mkdir -p node_modules/@deepseek-ai
for p in cordis cosmokit dsh-llm dsh-tools dsh-settings dsh-skill dsh-system-prompt dsh-tool-executor-native schemastery; do
  ln -sfn "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/$p" "node_modules/@deepseek-ai/$p"
done

You can also build the Harness from source and link this plugin the way it documents:

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
```

The settings page and config hot reload require a Harness >= `0.1.2-alpha.3` host; on older hosts the
plugin still runs on its boot-time config.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：> **Message source kind.** Since dsh `0.2` the harness has no shared catch-all `kind: 'plugin'`
> message source — each producer declares its own kind. This plugin injects under
> `'water-reminder'`, declared in [`types/dsh-llm.d.ts`](types/dsh-llm.d.ts). A pure-JavaScript
> plugin cannot use an inline `declare module` (that is TypeScript syntax, which Node rejects at parse
> time), so the type-level merge lives in that separate file.

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Prerequisites：Use the pinned install or the profile symlinks for the full suite
(`hydration.js` / `posture.js` / `notify.js`).

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Scripts：```sh
npm test              # 91 tests with dependencies; fewer pass + 2 skip without
npm run skill         # regenerate SKILL.md from skill.js
npm run skill:check   # verify SKILL.md is in sync
```

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Scripts：| File | Coverage | Needs Harness |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test/hydration.test.js` | Pure logic: band normalization, random-draw bounds, quiet hours across midnight, streaks, summary, config completion | no |
| `test/posture.test.js` | Pure logic: movement-track action set, band clamping, state normalization, break log and counts | no |
| `test/notify.test.js` | Exact per-platform `argv`, AppleScript/XML escaping, PowerShell encode round-trip | no |
| `test/skill.test.js` | Embedded skill identical to the on-disk `SKILL.md` byte for byte, spec-compliant name, tool names complete | no |
| `test/client-structure.test.js` | Browser half: theme token names, hard-coded fills, locale key parity | no |
| `test/plugin.test.js` | Tool behavior against a minimal fake context, asserting every result matches its own declared `output.schema` | **yes** |
| `test/integration.test.js` | Mounted on a **real** `Context` with the real `tools`/`skills`/`systemPrompt` services: dependency resolution, skill discoverability, clean disposal, and no disk writes during teardown | **yes** |

@dsh-plugin/water-reminder README · Scripts：When the packages are missing, the `plugin` and `integration` files **skip with a printed reason** instead of
turning the suite red.
